newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler details new management board duties.
newsitem.headline: Daimler details new management board duties.

text.p: Germany's largest industrial group, Daimler-Benz AG, gave the following details of the new responsibilities of its management board members following a restructuring which will take effect on April 1.
The restructuring is aimed at cutting costs and making Daimler more competitive in the global market place.
JUERGEN SCHREMPP, CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF MANAGEMENT
Corporate communications; international relations and corporate business; senior executives (with Human Resources); law; corporate audit; quality assurance; planning staff; corporate secretary.
JUERGEN HUBBERT, DIVISION PASSENGER CARS
S, E, C, A and M-class, embracing their development, production and purchasing and sales; Smart car.
KURT LAUK, DIVISION COMMERCIAL VEHICLES
Trucks, Western Europe; commercial vehicles, Latin America; commercial vehicles NAFTA; vans, Europe; buses, Europe; Unimog; drive trains, Europe.
DIETER ZETSCHE, SALES AND MARKETING
Eastern hemisphere; sales companies worldwide; sales organisation, development and strategic brand management, service and marketing academy, parts centres.
MANFRED BISCHOFF, DIVISION AEROSPACE
Dasa AG, embracing human resources and external relations; civil aircraft, including helicopters; military aircraft; space systems, infrastructure; space systems, satellites; defence; aeroengines.
KLAUS MANGOLD, DIVISION SERVICES
Debis AG, including human resources; financial services/insurance broking; IT services; telecommunications and media services; trading; real estate management.
ECKHARD CORDES, CORP. DEVELOP. RAIL SYSTEMS/MICROELECTRONIC
Corporate strategy; mergers and acquisitions; Adtranz; TEMIC; MTU Friedrichshafen; EHG.
MANFRED GENTZ, FINANCE/CONTROLLING
Controlling; financial statements; taxes; finance; investor and creditor relations; central purchasing and non-productive materials; date protection officer; corporate real estate management.
HEINER TROPITZSCH, HUMAN RESOURCES
Human resources and social policy; executive personnel development; training; human resources headquarters; organisation and data processing.
KLAUS-DIETER VOEHRINGER, RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
Research 1; Research 2; Research 3; Research 4; technology; intellectual property management; chief environmental protection officer.
